title: Variable Regions of p53 Isoforms Allosterically Hard Code DNA Interaction.
authors: Armour-Garb, Isabel; Han, In Sub Mark; Cowan, Benjamin S; Thayer, Kelly M
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟及MD sectors/Markov状态模型，系统研究p53异构体可变区对p53与共识DNA相互作用的别构调控，精准聚焦TF-DNA动态互作机制，方法先进且高度匹配课题。
abstract: Allosteric regulation of protein activity pervades biology as the "second secret of life." We have been examining the allosteric regulation and mutant reactivation of the tumor suppressor protein p53. We have found that generalizing the definition of allosteric effector to include entire proteins and expanding the meaning of binding site to include the interface of a transcription factor with its DNA to be useful in understanding the modulation of protein activity. Here, we cast the variable regions of p53 isoforms as allosteric regulators of p53 interactions with its consensus DNA. We implemented molecular dynamics simulations and our lab's new techniques of molecular dynamics (MD) sectors and MD-Markov state models to investigate the effects of nine naturally occurring splice variant isoforms of p53. We find that all of the isoforms differ from wild type in their dynamic properties and how they interact with the DNA. We consider the implications of these findings on allostery and cancer treatment.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质活性的变构调节贯穿生物学，被誉为“生命的第二秘密”。我们一直在研究肿瘤抑制蛋白p53的变构调节及突变体再激活机制。我们发现，将变构效应子的定义泛化以涵盖整个蛋白质，并将结合位点的含义扩展至转录因子与其DNA的界面，对于理解蛋白质活性的调节颇为有用。在此，我们将p53异构体的可变区域视为p53与其共识DNA相互作用的变构调节因子。我们实施了分子动力学模拟，并运用本实验室的新技术——分子动力学（MD）扇区及MD-马尔可夫状态模型，来研究p53的九种天然剪接变异异构体的效应。我们发现，所有异构体在动态特性及其与DNA的相互作用方式上均与野生型存在差异。我们探讨了这些发现对变构调控及癌症治疗的意义。
